terminal.basis: Final-year normalized NOPAT less sustainable reinvestment g/ROIC

sbc_treatment.note: Future SBC is charged to earnings and never added back; current award dilution uses the disclosed Q2 reconciliation proxy. Small notes convert. Large note tested as debt and as shares, taking the lower common-equity value; not an option-pricing model. Current award proxy 312.5m basic plus awards is approximate, not reported period-end fully diluted shares; June cash held constant, no September balance sheet claim. Operating leases remain in operating costs. Oracle issued shares already counted; existing noncash customer consideration amortization excluded from economic FCFF. Small-note July redemption settlement uncertainty immaterial but open.
